nodes.label: CFA model is purely cell-mediated, no autoantibody role (superseded: contradicted by Feige 1994)

nodes.norm_label: cfa model is purely cell-mediated, no autoantibody role (superseded: contradicted by feige 1994)

nodes.label: Minimum endpoint core for acceptance in rat AIA
nodes.rationale: Full-text frequencies (n=29): clinical severity 100%, paw 93%, at least one of TNF/IL-1beta/IL-6 86%, histology 69%, body weight 69%; 0/29 reported a sample-size calculation.
nodes.norm_label: minimum endpoint core for acceptance in rat aia

nodes.label: PEA glucocorticoid-sparing dose-reduction design
nodes.rationale: No study tested whether PEA allows prednisolone dose reduction in arthritis; comparable sparing designs exist with other agents (gemfibrozil, curcumin, piperine, niacin, escin).

nodes.label: No PEA head-to-head comparison with JAK or calcineurin inhibitor
nodes.rationale: Zero hits for PEA with baricitinib, tofacitinib or tacrolimus in any searched database (2 Oct 2026).
nodes.norm_label: no pea head-to-head comparison with jak or calcineurin inhibitor

nodes.label: Oral micronized PEA over CFA polyarthritis with immunological endpoints in rats
nodes.rationale: Oral PEA with cytokines exists only in MIA osteoarthritis; no ACPA, NF-kB p65 IHC or p38 endpoint with PEA in any arthritis model found (6 Oct 2026).
nodes.norm_label: oral micronized pea over cfa polyarthritis with immunological endpoints in rats

nodes.label: PEA oxidative-stress panel in adjuvant arthritis rats
nodes.rationale: Still novel for AIA rats only; Impellizzeri 2013 already measured MDA in CIA mice, so the claim must not say first oxidative-stress data in arthritis.
nodes.norm_label: pea oxidative-stress panel in adjuvant arthritis rats

nodes.label: Target 8 evaluable animals per group; costly assays on random 6
nodes.rationale: Mead equation gives n=3 for k=9, below the BJP n>=5 floor; power for d>=2.5 vs CFA needs 5-6 per group; cost driver is ELISA/IHC, so subsample those.
nodes.norm_label: target 8 evaluable animals per group; costly assays on random 6

nodes.label: Single primary outcome: AUC of arthritis score D16-45 with ANCOVA on D15
nodes.rationale: One primary outcome limits multiplicity; summary-measure AUC is a valid, efficient analysis for serial measurements; Day-15 covariate gains power at no cost.
nodes.norm_label: single primary outcome: auc of arthritis score d16-45 with ancova on d15

nodes.label: Non-inferiority vs prednisolone 10 not feasible; report C3 as estimate with CI
nodes.rationale: With realistic variance a 50% margin needs about 31 per group; a non-significant result must not be read as equivalence.
nodes.norm_label: non-inferiority vs prednisolone 10 not feasible; report c3 as estimate with ci

nodes.label: Pre-specify and date-stamp analysis plan before Day 0 (OSF)
